edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: The Cleverlys bring their Ozark bluegrass-comedy to Walhalla Friday night, a full moon rises over Jocassee the same evening, and Jazz on the Alley still owns Ram Cat Alley on Thursday — while Jocassee Valley Brewing stacks four straight nights of live music through Sunday.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: The Cleverlys
events.body: A bluegrass band out of the remote Ozarks that plays it dead straight and completely absurd at the same time — sharp picking wrapped around deadpan comedy. One night only at the old Walhalla auditorium.

events.title: Full Moon Rising Tour
events.body: Same easy, slow-moving boat as the Saturday sunset run, timed instead to watch the moon come up full over Jocassee Dam as the sky goes dark. A waterfall or two along the way, as always.

events.title: Sunset Lake Tour
events.body: A slower two-hour run out onto Jocassee as the light goes gold over the mountains, with a waterfall or two along the way. Runs every Saturday evening through the season.
events.note: $65 · 2 hours · every Saturday · Jocassee Lake Tours

events.title: Snorkel Adventure Tour
events.body: New this year — a guided look at what's actually swimming around in Jocassee's clear water, fish and invertebrates included. Longer than the boat tours, and good for kids 4 and up.

events.title: Four nights of live music at Jocassee Valley
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing in Salem has a full lineup posted: Old Time Jam Thursday, The Binge Friday, Done Gone Boys Saturday, and Jazzy Trinity closing it out Sunday afternoon, each with a food truck alongside. Keowee Brewing in Seneca runs its usual free Friday and Saturday music too — check its calendar for who's on.
events.note: Free · sets start 6:30pm Thu–Sat, 4pm Sun at Jocassee Valley · Keowee Brewing Fri & Sat, lineup TBD

plan.title: Comedy, bluegrass, or moonlight on the water
plan.body: The Cleverlys hit the WPAC stage at 7:30, or skip the auditorium and catch the full moon rise over Jocassee instead. Either way, get out on the water for the afternoon first.
plan.label: See the Cleverlys ↗

plan.title: A ramp, a swim, then the sunset tour
plan.body: No headline event Saturday during the day — find a ramp, get on the water, then book the Jocassee sunset run for the evening.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Snorkel it, or just keep it slow
plan.body: The new snorkel tour runs most of the day if you want something different. Otherwise pick a swim beach, check today's lake level, or grab a table on the water before you head out.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
